subject.title: [Bug]: macos say command in daemon not output to speakers

question: What macOS daemon-to-speaker behavior should OpenClaw officially support for Local CLI TTS when the Gateway runs under launchd?
rationale: The current generic Local CLI provider can run a wrapper, but adding a built-in GUI-session bridge would set macOS service/security expectations and needs maintainer intent plus live proof.

options.title: Document wrapper contract
options.body: Keep the provider generic and document a supported `launchctl asuser` wrapper that discovers the active GUI user/session without hard-coded UIDs, validated with macOS launchd proof.

options.title: Add plugin-owned helper
options.body: Implement a Local CLI plugin helper for macOS GUI-session playback, with tests around command construction and live launchd evidence before closing the issue.

options.title: Declare unsupported
options.body: Document that custom system-user LaunchDaemon speaker playback is outside the shipped LaunchAgent contract and close only after the docs clearly say so.

recommendation.title: Document wrapper contract
recommendation.body: Keep the provider generic and document a supported `launchctl asuser` wrapper that discovers the active GUI user/session without hard-coded UIDs, validated with macOS launchd proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Most central history combines the adopted Local CLI provider/docs and repeated launchd service lifecycle work.
